repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `57e988ac2247a28ed81a799fb0fb47fa1fa67e4e` · 2026-11-25T09:44Z

- Scope: PR #37264 (draft → `main`), `Fixes #37250`. 4 files, +129/−1: `.changeset/37250-fill-in-dialog-pending-options.md`, `ui/packages/fields/src/RequiredFieldsDialog.tsx`, `ui/packages/fields/src/requiredWhenPrompt.ts`, and the `RequiredFieldsDialog.inPlace-35956` test. All files are inside the claim's file surface (claim comment 7156052572). Nothing touches `content/docs/releases/`.
- Root cause, not a mask. At merge-base `d7f299c0b1e`, the dialog rendered `<FieldEditWidget field value onChange>` with no `dependentValues`. `useCascadingOptions` resolves `dependentValues ?? {}` and has no context fallback (retired under objectui#7206). So every option `visibleWhen` in the dialog was judged on `{}`. The collector already judges on `next = { ...record, ...changes }` (`requiredWhenPrompt.ts`, unchanged). The fix carries that same `next` to the controls, and the dialog adds the typed values on top. Dev claims 1–3 hold as stated.
- Hosts: kanban (`ObjectKanban.tsx`), `recordPathStageChange.tsx`, `InlineEditSaveBar.tsx` and `objectGridRequiredPrompt.tsx` all label their fields with `{ ...f, def, label }`. `record` therefore reaches the dialog on every collected row and every `moreFields` row with no host edit.
- Pins re-run at head in a scratch worktree at `57e988ac224`, using `vitest run … RequiredFieldsDialog.inPlace-35956.test.tsx`: **11/11 passed**.
- Ablation readings (same file):
  - Collector ablation (drop `record: next`): **4 failed / 7 passed**. All four #37250 cases fail.
  - Dialog ablation (drop `dependentValues={liveRecord}`): **3 failed / 8 passed**. The three dialog cases fail; the collector case passes.
  - Main source (both src files at merge-base, new test kept): **4 failed / 7 passed**. The 7 pre-existing cases pass, which is the positive control.
- Full `@object-ui/fields` suite at head: **329 files passed, 1 skipped; 5020 tests passed, 7 skipped** (`vitest run packages/fields`, ~574 s). That matches the dev's 5020.
- Check-runs on `57e988ac224`: 57 runs, **44 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed**. Named: Lint & Repo Gates `success`, TypeScript Type Check `success`, Type Check UI `success`, Lint UI `success`, Check Changeset `success`. GitHub reports `mergeable_state: clean`.
- K = 8 against `origin/main` @ `ede9b91f402`. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 57e988ac224` is clean. Main has moved nothing under `ui/packages/{fields,plugin-detail,plugin-grid}` since the merge-base.
- Overlap: I listed the files of all 42 other open PRs. None touches `RequiredFieldsDialog*`, `requiredWhenPrompt*`, `useCascadingOptions*`, `recordPathStageChange*`, `InlineEditSaveBar*` or `objectGridRequiredPrompt*`. No open issue mentions `refusalField`.
- Changeset level: `patch` is right. AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3 sets the level by the `Metadata-protocol` kind alone. `none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right too: no metadata key, value or default moves.
- M1 (must-fix) — `Clause-②: no` is a false declaration. The criterion (execution-duties.md) asks whether the card relaxes an accept set or enlarges the public surface. The public surface is what the built entry `.d.ts` reaches.
  - `@object-ui/fields` 18.6.0 is published (not `private`; `exports["."].types = ./dist/index.d.ts`). Its `index.tsx` re-exports `type RequiredWhenPromptField`, and `RequiredFieldsDialogField extends` it. That interface reaches `RequiredFieldsDialogProps.fields` and `refusalField`.
  - The new `record?: Record<string, unknown>` therefore widens both the exported shape and the props the dialog accepts.
  - Repo practice for exactly this shape is `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. Examples in `ui/packages/fields/CHANGELOG.md`: "`ActionParamDef` gains one optional member, `widget?: string`" and "the exported `RecordPointer` type gains the optional `deletedLabel`".
  - Fix: write `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line-initial in the PR body, the changeset body and the claim comment 7156052572. The queue gate reads only the claim comment. Then route the declared widening to a `TIER_DEFAULT` L2 (contract-review.md) before ready or queue.
  - The dev flagged the member "For the L1" in comment 7157459458. The seat carried the claim's pre-design `no` forward.
- S1 (should-fix) — Two sentences of shipping text understate the defect and the fix.
  - Changeset ¶1 says: "This happened when the field's options are each shown only for some values of the field the change writes." That is one sufficient case, not the condition. With no record handed over, any option `visibleWhen` reading any record field was judged on `{}`. That includes fields the change does not write. In addition, every `dependsOn`-gated option list and every dependent lookup in the dialog stayed on its "select the parent first" gate (`isOptionGroupGated(dependsOn, {})`). The progress comment itself says the cause "is broader than the card says".
  - 维护者速读 「出错会怎样」 says "只影响补填弹窗里下拉、单选等选项的显示". `dependentValues` also feeds dependent-lookup filters (`LookupField`), `CurrencyField`'s followed currency and the option widgets' cascade-clear.
  - Fix: restate the condition as "the dialog handed its controls no record". Name the `dependsOn` gates and dependent lookups among what now resolves. Widen 「出错会怎样」 to "how the dialog's controls read the record". 「为什么做」 has the same narrowing ("没有用到这次待保存的改动"): the dialog used no record at all, so it should say that.
- Changeset, sentence by sentence, other than M1 and S1:
  - Title: true.
  - ¶1, the hosts list (stage move, list cell, inline edit, kanban drop): true against the four hosts above.
  - "No options available": true. It is the `fields.options.empty` copy.
  - The loss-reason example: true.
  - ¶2 "saved record, the change, and the values typed": true (`liveRecord`).
  - "appears once that value is typed": pinned by case 4.
  - "not visible on that record stay hidden": pinned by case 3.
  - "fields asked for do not change": true. The collector's selection is untouched.
  - ¶3 "now carries `record`" and "hands it, with the typed values, to every control as `dependentValues`": true.
  - "reads the same record when the dialog has a field that carries one": true as far as it goes. It leaves out the zero-field case, which the PR body does state.
  - "No metadata key, value or default changes": true.
- 维护者速读, sentence by sentence, other than S1: 「用户能看到什么变化」 is true. 「要你做什么：无」 holds: an L2 review is a seat route, not a maintainer action.
- `refusalField` rows: the PR is honest about them. The PR body's acceptance notes, the changeset ¶3, the `record` TSDoc ("Absent on a row a host builds itself") and the progress comment all state the gap.
  - Read at head: `refusalField` in all three hosts returns `label({ name, def: { name, ...def } })` with no record.
  - In the stage-menu confirmation (zero collected fields), `judged` is `undefined`. A refusal-added option row then reads only the typed values, without even the stage change.
  - This is no worse than main (`{}`), and the hosts are outside the claim's file surface, so leaving them out is right.
  - Owed: **one** follow-up card covering `recordPathStageChange.tsx`, `InlineEditSaveBar.tsx` and `objectGridRequiredPrompt.tsx`. All three share one fix shape: each `refusalField` sets `record` to the stored record with the change, through the member this PR adds. The pin is a stage-menu confirmation whose refusal names `loss_reason`.
  - The `ObjectTimesheet.tsx` add-row note (line 637, no `dependentValues`) is confirmed. It is a different dialog and not a pending-change case, so it is a separate card if the seat files it. It should not be folded into the `refusalField` card.
- N1 — The card's triage "Done when" asks for a `win_reason` (→ `closed_won`) pin as well. The mechanism is field-agnostic, and case 3's won-only option is the inverse check. Acceptable as is.
- N2 — The dev's report reads "each of the two ablations turns 3 red". Measured here, the collector ablation turns 4 red (it also reds the collector assertion) and the dialog ablation turns 3 red. Record the measured pair.
- N3 — `recordPathStageChange` recomputes `asked` (`fieldsNeededAt`) on every host render. `judged`, and so `liveRecord`, take a new identity per render. No effect loop was found: the option widgets' cascade-clear is idempotent, and the dialog passes no `onAutofill`. Note only.
- Patch round: M1 and S1 are text-only (PR body, changeset and claim comment). The changeset edit moves the head, and the PR is then owed a `TIER_DEFAULT` L2 on the declared widening before it can be accepted.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `f731d2461f22d8480492ec2095bdfa17d6399eaa`
Local-runs: probe — one declaration build of @object-ui/fields (vite build, vite-plugin-dts) at merge-base d7f299c0b1e and at head, to diff the published .d.ts
Scope: declaration face, no hits floor (record-recognisers: the paths decide no face; the changeset's Clause-② line gives --face declaration). Whole diff read: .changeset/37250-fill-in-dialog-pending-options.md, ui/packages/fields/src/requiredWhenPrompt.ts, ui/packages/fields/src/RequiredFieldsDialog.tsx, ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/RequiredFieldsDialog.inPlace-35956.test.tsx

### ① Derived judgments

- What is declared: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. `readClause2Line` and `readMetadataProtocolLine` read exactly this on the PR body, the changeset at this head and claim comment 7156052572.
- Is the member optional and additive? Yes.
  - The emitted declarations differ between merge-base and head in one file only, `requiredWhenPrompt.d.ts`. The diff is +`record?` (a `Record` of string to unknown) with its TSDoc, on `interface RequiredWhenPromptField`.
  - `index.d.ts:1180` re-exports `type RequiredWhenPromptField`. `RequiredFieldsDialog.d.ts:4` has `RequiredFieldsDialogField extends RequiredWhenPromptField`. That puts the member in `RequiredFieldsDialogProps.fields`, in the return type of `moreFields` and in the return type of `refusalField`.
  - Every one of those positions is host-supplied input to the dialog, or collector output the host passes through. In both cases an optional member only widens what is accepted.
  - No existing object literal or host type stops compiling. Type Check UI and TypeScript Type Check are `success` on this head.
- Is anything in the published `.d.ts` narrowed? No.
  - `RequiredFieldsDialog.d.ts` is byte-identical between merge-base and head.
  - No function signature changed. `collectRequiredWhenPromptFields` still returns `RequiredWhenPromptField[]`.
  - No member became required, and no union lost an arm.
- Runtime: `collectRequiredWhenPromptFields` now sets `record` on every element it returns. This adds a key to each returned object. It is not a type change.

### ② Semver level

- `'@object-ui/fields': patch` is right.
  - The level follows the `Metadata-protocol:` kind alone: `none` takes `patch`.
  - A non-protocol widening of a TypeScript export ships `patch`. Repo precedent in `ui/packages/fields/CHANGELOG.md`: `ActionParamDef` gaining `widget?`, and `RecordPointer` gaining `deletedLabel`.
  - No metadata key, value or default moves, so `Metadata-protocol: none` holds.
- Check Changeset is `success` on this head.
- The changeset's prose has one inaccurate sentence: "Options that are not visible on that record stay hidden". It is false for unguarded conditions, which failed open before. This is the L1's S2. It does not touch the level or the declaration.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag, the hosts' `refusalField` rows carrying no record: answered. They are outside the file surface, no worse than main, and filed as #37270.
- Dev flag, `ObjectTimesheet.tsx` add-row with no `dependentValues`: noted, and a separate card if filed.
- No `open_questions` entry is left unanswered.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The change is client-side predicate input only. There is no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join.

  - The path: `useCascadingOptions` → `dependentValues ?? {}` → `resolveVisibleOptions` → `evalFieldPredicate(…, fallback = true)`. A not-ok engine verdict returns the fallback.

  - Fix: change it to 12/12, and add the mirror case to `## Tests`. This is a body-only edit and does not move the head.
- S2 (should-fix) — Changeset ¶3 says "Options that are not visible on that record stay hidden." That contradicts the changeset's own ¶1 for unguarded conditions.
  - ¶1 says an unguarded condition "could not be evaluated, and the option was offered whatever the condition said". The probe confirms that: unguarded `record.stage == "closed_lost"` was offered on `{}`.
  - At head the record carries `stage`. The same option is now **hidden** on `stage: negotiation`, so it does not "stay" hidden.
  - For an app that writes its option predicates without `has()`, this PR takes options out of the dialog that it offered before. That is the one user-visible narrowing in the change, and the changelog sentence tells consumers it does not happen.
  - It is not a contract narrowing: the declared `visibleWhen` is honoured, and the code is correct. It is shipping text that understates the change.
  - Fix: restate it as "Options that are not visible on that record are hidden, including those whose condition could not be evaluated before and so were offered."
  - The 速读's 「都按这次改动后的记录来显示」 already covers both directions, so no 速读 edit is needed for this.
- N1 — The `RequiredFieldsDialog.tsx` comment above `liveRecord` (source, unchanged this round) says "with no record handed over every option reading the field the change writes was judged hidden". That is true only for `has()`-guarded conditions. Correct it if the head moves anyway for S2. Not owed on its own.

  - A wrong record would also mis-filter lookup candidates. It would also set an amount's currency width, and `CurrencyField` rounds typed input on blur at that width.
  - Suggested wording: 「若有误，弹窗里的选项、关联记录候选或金额小数位可能不对；保存前可见，可直接撤回本次改动」.
- N3 — The changeset's ¶1 phrase "A condition guarded by `has(record.x)` was false" fits the `has(…) && …` idiom only. A `!has(record.x)` condition was true on `{}`. Note only.
- Patch round:
  - S1 is a body edit, and the head does not move.
  - S2 edits the changeset, so the head moves. The `TIER_DEFAULT` record on `f731d2461f2` then names a stale head. A changeset-only delta needs a fresh record on the new head, and its re-check is the Clause-② reading plus the check-runs.
  - Make the S2 edit, and the N1 comment fix if wanted, in one commit.
